t: This LAP Outdoor LED Recessed Deck Light Kit provides robust and long-lasting illumination for exterior spaces. Featuring a durable stainless steel body and polycarbonate lens, these lights are IP67 rated for all-weather outdoor use, making them ideal for garden patios, pathways, and decking areas. The brushed chrome finish adds a modern aesthetic. Designed for a 23mm cut-out, adjustable legs ensure a secure fit for each of the 10 units. Operating on a 220-240V mains power supply, the kit includes an LED driver and fixings, delivering a complete and efficient cool white 4000K lighting solution.
